title: Learn about the Human Genetics Calculator in our upcoming webinar
summary: Join us on Thursday, March 11th at 12pm U.S. Eastern time for a webinar featuring an innovative new tool being developed in Jason Flannick's group.
bodyHtml:
Join us on Thursday, March 11th at 12pm U.S. Eastern time for a webinar featuring an innovative new tool being developed in Jason Flannick's group. The Human Genetics Calculator (HuGe Calculator) integrates several kinds of genetic evidence to quantify human genetic support for involvement of a gene in a phenotype or disease of interest, with the aim of helping researchers prioritize genes. It will soon be available in the Common Metabolic Diseases Knowledge Portal and its component disease-specific portals.
